sites.name: KLCC precinct
sites.context: Explore public-realm improvements and building reuse; verify park ownership and planning restrictions.

sites.name: KL Sentral precinct
sites.context: Explore a transit-oriented mixed-use concept; verify walking routes, capacity and permitted density.

sites.name: Kampung Baru precinct
sites.context: Explore sensitive infill and adaptive reuse; verify tenure, heritage, community needs and flood exposure.

strategies.name: Permeable walkway
strategies.recommendation: Study recycled permeable pavers with shaded walking routes. Check subgrade infiltration, drainage outlets and maintenance access before choosing the pavement.

strategies.name: Development concept
strategies.recommendation: Compare mixed-use infill with community and commercial uses. Treat the entered area as gross floor area. Confirm zoning, ownership, transport capacity, terrain and flood constraints before ranking development suitability.

strategies.name: Building retrofit
strategies.recommendation: Study retention of the existing structure, recycled finishes and external shading. Assess rainwater harvesting separately. A structural and energy audit is needed to confirm feasibility.
